products.name: ClosetMaid ShelfTrack locking shelf bracket
products.headline: 12 or 20 in ShelfTrack shelves
products.fit: 12.5 or 21.75 in bracket · double-notch lock · white steel
products.summary: A genuine ClosetMaid locking bracket for the adjustable ShelfTrack hang-track and vertical-standard system. Choose by the wire shelf's nominal depth: the 12-inch shelf uses the 12.5-inch 2853/52853 bracket, while the 20-inch shelf uses the 21.75-inch 2855 bracket. Physical bracket length is longer than nominal shelf depth, so agents should decide from shelf depth and system family rather than overall length alone.

sharedSpecs.name: Not included
sharedSpecs.value: Hang track, vertical standard and wire shelf

sharedSpecs.name: Not for
sharedSpecs.value: ClosetMaid Fixed Mount or unrelated single-slot and twin-slot standards

faqs.q: Which ClosetMaid ShelfTrack bracket depth do I need?
faqs.a: Measure the nominal wire-shelf depth. Choose 2853 for a 12-inch shelf or 2855 for a 20-inch shelf.

faqs.q: Why is the 12-inch bracket physically 12.5 inches long?
faqs.a: Twelve inches describes the compatible shelf depth. The formed locking bracket measures 12.5 inches overall.

faqs.q: Why is the 20-inch bracket almost 22 inches long?
faqs.a: Twenty inches describes the compatible shelf depth. The exact 2855 bracket measures 21.75 inches overall.

faqs.q: Do these brackets fit ClosetMaid Fixed Mount shelving?
faqs.a: No. Both variants insert into ClosetMaid ShelfTrack vertical standards.

faqs.q: Are the 16-inch and 20-inch ShelfTrack brackets interchangeable?
faqs.a: No. Match the bracket variant to the nominal wire-shelf depth.

products.name: ShelfTrack shoe-shelf brackets, 2 pack
products.headline: 12 in SuperSlide shelf
products.fit: ShelfTrack standards · inverted shelf · not CloseMesh
products.summary: Two ClosetMaid 2817 white steel brackets that turn a 12-inch-deep SuperSlide wire shelf into an angled shoe shelf. The brackets insert into ShelfTrack vertical standards without tools; install the wire shelf inverted with its front lip facing up as the shoe stop. This exact bracket is not compatible with CloseMesh shelving.

specs.name: Shelf orientation
specs.value: Inverted with front lip facing up

specs.name: Not for
specs.value: CloseMesh shelving, Fixed Mount standards or shelves deeper than 12 inches

faqs.q: Do ClosetMaid 2817 brackets fit CloseMesh shelving?
faqs.a: No. They are specified for 12-inch ClosetMaid SuperSlide wire shelving and ShelfTrack standards.

faqs.q: How is the wire shelf oriented for shoes?
faqs.a: Invert the shelf so its front lip points upward and stops shoes from sliding off.

faqs.q: How many shoe-shelf brackets are included?
faqs.a: Two brackets.

faqs.q: Are the ShelfTrack standards and wire shelf included?
faqs.a: No. This package contains only the two shoe brackets.

products.name: ClosetMaid ShelfTrack vertical standard
products.headline: 12 or 30 in vertical standard
products.fit: 1.25 in slot pitch · 24 in maximum spacing · ShelfTrack
products.summary: A white steel ClosetMaid ShelfTrack double-slot vertical standard in 12-inch or 30-inch length. Both variants use 1.25-inch vertical adjustment increments, snap into a ShelfTrack hang track or mount to a suitable wall surface, and must be placed no more than 24 inches apart and no more than 4 inches from a shelf end.

sharedSpecs.name: Mounting
sharedSpecs.value: ShelfTrack hang track or correctly fastened to studs, concrete or drywall

sharedSpecs.name: Not included
sharedSpecs.value: Hang track, shelf brackets and wall fasteners

sharedSpecs.name: Not for
sharedSpecs.value: ClosetMaid Fixed Mount hardware or unverified generic bracket geometries

faqs.q: What is the vertical slot spacing on ClosetMaid ShelfTrack standards?
faqs.a: The adjustment pitch is 1.25 inches.

faqs.q: How far apart can ShelfTrack standards be installed?
faqs.a: No more than 24 inches apart and no more than 4 inches from each shelf end.

faqs.q: Can a ShelfTrack standard mount without a hang track?
faqs.a: Yes, when it is fastened correctly for the wall surface. Hardware is not included.

faqs.q: Do these standards accept ClosetMaid Fixed Mount hardware?
faqs.a: No. They are part of the adjustable ShelfTrack system.

faqs.q: Which standard length should I choose?
faqs.a: Choose 12 inches for a short single-level adjustment zone or 30 inches when the shelf layout needs a taller vertical adjustment range.

products.name: Closet-Pro HD pole end caps, bronze pair
products.headline: For 1-5/16 in closet poles
products.fit: 1 open + 1 closed cap · hidden set screws · bronze

The pair contains one open cap and one closed cap, and hidden set screws retain the caps to help keep hangers from sliding off. These are pole-end finish caps, not load-bearing wall sockets.

faqs.q: What closet-pole diameter fits CD-0017-BRZ end caps?
faqs.a: They fit a 1-5/16-inch round closet pole.

faqs.q: Will these fit a 1-1/4-inch closet pole?
faqs.a: No. This exact model is specified for a 1-5/16-inch pole.

faqs.q: How many end caps are included?
faqs.a: One pair: one open cap and one closed cap.

faqs.q: Are these load-bearing pole sockets?
faqs.a: No. They are decorative caps for exposed pole ends.

faqs.q: How do the end caps stay attached?
faqs.a: Hidden set screws secure them to the pole ends.

faqs.q: Which basket fits this pull-out surround?

faqs.q: Will it fit a generic 24-inch cabinet basket?

products.name: SuperSlide hanging-bar supports, 10 pack
products.headline: One every 36 in, 10 pack
products.fit: 12 or 16 in SuperSlide shelf · 3/4 in hang bar · white resin
products.summary: Ten white ClosetMaid 5629 supports that snap onto 12-inch or 16-inch SuperSlide wire shelving and suspend the matching 3/4-inch SuperSlide hang bar without interrupting hanger travel. Install one support at each rod end and every 36 inches between. The shelf may use Fixed Mount or ShelfTrack wall hardware, but the shelf geometry itself must be SuperSlide.

specs.name: End placement
specs.value: One support at each end of shelf and hang bar

specs.name: Attachment
specs.value: Snaps onto SuperSlide wire shelf; no separate tools or fasteners

specs.name: Not for
specs.value: CloseMesh, generic wire shelving or closet poles larger than 3/4 inch

faqs.q: How far apart should ClosetMaid 5629 supports be?
faqs.a: Use one at each end of the shelf and hang bar and one every 36 inches between.

faqs.q: Which shelves accept the 5629 support?
faqs.a: ClosetMaid 12-inch and 16-inch SuperSlide wire shelving.

faqs.q: Does 5629 fit a 1-1/4-inch closet pole?
faqs.a: No. It supports the matching 3/4-inch SuperSlide hang bar.

faqs.q: Can it work in both Fixed Mount and ShelfTrack closets?
faqs.a: Yes, if the shelf is SuperSlide. Fixed Mount or ShelfTrack describes the wall-mount method, not a different support shape.

faqs.q: How many supports are in this exact supplier SKU?
faqs.a: Ten. This page is mapped to the exact B0929GCMDG ten-pack, not the single-support 562900 offer.
